**Overview:**  
Sinar Everbright Trading Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company engaged in online retail of baby products and toys, operating from Kuala Lumpur. The firm was incorporated on 29 December 2007 and has a paid‑up share capital of 100,000. It reports five directors, with the largest shareholder owning 72.7% of the equity. Recent financial snapshots show revenues of 1,669,234; 1,406,878; and 1,115,956 (currency not specified) across three reporting periods, with equity around 1.27 million. No court cases are recorded.
